root: ^Ok Ace, Huxley should be just on the other side of the compound!
^Looks like he's got alot of his mercenaries protecting him, can You help out?
^Yeah yeah of course, just run me through it again won’t ya?
^A bit rusty aye? Ok here we go… Listen up because I’m only gonna remind you once!
^To move left and right, use the A and D keys. To jump, use the W Key, hold for bigger jumps.
^On your way you’ll see some coins. Pick them up to earn money, you’ll be able to start using them soon.
^Once you start getting closer to your bounty Huxley, his mercenaries are going to start attacking you.
^To defeat them, use the mouse to aim and click to shoot your gun. Oh! And to reload the gun, use the Spacebar.
^Watch out! If you get hit by an enemy you lose health!
